title: Grilled Yellow Pepper and Nano Corn Salad
description: A colorful and flavorful summer salad featuring grilled yellow peppers and nano corn, perfect for a light and refreshing meal.
instructions: Brush yellow peppers with oil and grill for 5-7 minutes per side, until charred.
Let peppers cool, then cut into strips.
In a large bowl, combine grilled peppers, cooked vialone rice, and nano corn.
Stir in gooey cheese until well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
